column1: # The SHIPPED configuration, measured. nelder_mead=true throughout: the demotion
# was abandoned on measurement, so true is what ships. g_tol is left at its 1e-4
# default. The arc's 2.0486 s was taken at nelder_mead=false and g_tol=1e-6 and
# describes no shipped path; this file replaces it.
# LABEL CORRECTION, appended after f667dffb0 reverted moment_start to opt-in:
# the row named SHIPPED is hessian=:grad_fd WITH moment_start=true, which is NOT
# the shipped default any more. The shipped default is the HESS row
# (hessian=:grad_fd, moment_start=false). The SHIPPED row is retained as the
# opt-in configuration's measurement. This file's own header rule, that a
# benchmark must carry its keyword configuration, is what makes the mislabel
# recoverable: every row states hess and moment explicitly.
